tools.name: unity-asset-creator-20261019.json
tools.description: Walk one Unity world asset through the researched 12-step checklist, from plan and provenance to colliders, lighting and the in-world review: a failed check blocks its step. Then export a versioned package with previews and a checksummed manifest, and open a pull request to unity-assets-library.
tools.command_template: Copy everything inside scripts/unity-asset-creator/ into the world project's folder (its Assets/ and Tools/ merge in), then run Unity Unicorn > Asset Creator > Open checklist window. To publish an export: python -I Tools/unity-asset-creator/publish-asset-20261018.py --library <clone of findastra/unity-assets-library>
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with the VRChat Worlds SDK (built-in render pipeline); the asset is one prefab in its own folder.
Python 3, git and a signed-in GitHub CLI to publish. gh started from Python may say it is not signed in; the script then prints the gh pr create command to run from the shell.
Astra's own review in the world (step 11) before an export, and her merge for every library pull request.
limitations: Steps 3, 7 and 11 need a person's confirmation note, and a warning passes only with a note that says why it is acceptable here.
The checks enforce budgets and rules for one asset; they do not judge looks. The checklist's Craft section and Astra's review decide that.
Incubated in findastra/liminal-doors (branch claude/fresh-start-20261018) and copied here unchanged on 2026-10-19; the booth and the sky are the only assets through it so far.
